findings.evidence: /tmp/uri_review_R4/probe_policy.py: DEVTEST fixture, config protected_paths='ws_frozen_check', repo/scripts/ws_frozen_check.py PROTECTED=('core/',...), candidate changes core/frozen.py. Run 1 (reviewer script absent) -> WAITING_FOR_MODEL, PLAN event protected=['core/','scripts/ws_frozen_check.py']. Then only the main checkout's working-tree scripts/ws_frozen_check.py was edited to PROTECTED=('nothing/',) (config file byte-identical) and the reviewer script created. Run 2 -> VERIFIED; events contain no CONFIG_CHANGED; changed_paths(base,candidate) includes core/frozen.py; L.verify(cfg) == []; evidence_ok == (True, []). policy(cfg) is recorded in PLAN/CONFIG_CHANGED but never compared; config_binding() compares only _config_sha256. The main checkout is excluded from integrity checks (doc §6), so a worker, another session, or a branch switch/pull in the main checkout silently relaxes L-AC11.
findings.suggested_fix: Bind and compare the resolved policy, not just the file hash: e.g. compute chash(policy(cfg)) (with the resolved protected list) into PLAN/CONFIG_CHANGED and have config_binding/run block CONFIG when it differs; or resolve 'ws_frozen_check' once at PLAN time (or from the baseline commit via git show <baseline>:scripts/ws_frozen_check.py) and read the protected list from the chain thereafter. Add a regression test that edits ws_frozen_check.py between runs.
findings.title: Policy binding covers only the config file hash: the default protected list (ws_frozen_check) is re-read every run from the main checkout's working tree and a relaxed list reaches VERIFIED with no CONFIG_CHANGED and verify() clean

findings.evidence: /tmp/uri_review_R4/probe_skip.py: candidate sets VALUE=3 in pkg/other.py and adds @pytest.mark.skip to tests/test_other.py::test_value; qualify() -> ok True, comparison {new_failures:[], vanished:[], ok:True}, skipped 1. compare() treats skipped ids as present. For a GATE finding, the skipped test file exits 0 after and failed before, so regression_proof passes; only the independent re-review stands in the way.
findings.suggested_fix: Record skipped ids per gate and treat 'passed on baseline, skipped on candidate' like vanished (unless allowed_flaky); in regression_proof require the gate test to have run (not all-skipped) after the repair.
findings.title: A baseline-passing test newly skipped in the candidate is not a gate regression (and satisfies a gate-finding regression proof)
